en:
I'll bring him back to my apartment tonight.
That's probably the safest place in town.
Oh, right...

You can come, too. It's small,
but we'll figure it out.
A-Are y'sure?
Yeah. You should be with your son.
Thank you so much.
Kiryu-san. Tsuneo's trickier than y'think.

He's bound to come fer the baby sooner
or later. Don't let your guard down.

Thank you. We'll be
heading out now, Hirose-san.

Kiryu-aniki. Y'really did a lot fer us today.
Try n' get some rest, okay?

All this shit's makin' my head spin.
It's been real tough t'follow.

I gotta wonder what kinda secret
Onomichi's been hidin' from us, though.
I'm so glad t'see Haruto's back safe.
Aniki. Let's head over t'yer apartment.
Where're you going, Aniki?
Where are you, Aniki?
It's strange.

You said earlier that you thought
blood ties are meaningless...

...But it's tough to deny how
good having a son makes you feel.

I'd do whatever it takes to protect him,
down to putting my own life on the line.
Good to hear.
Truth is, I was kind of an angry kid.

The orphanage was the only home I knew,
and that punk Tatsukawa was my only friend.

I wanted to hate my parents for abandoning me,
but I couldn't even remember their faces.
My life seemed totally worthless.

Not much proved otherwise. Even my invitation
into the Hirose Family was 'cause of Tatsukawa.

Now that I think about it, he probly only did it
so it'd be easier for him n' Masuzoe to track me.

That all said, joining the Hirose was the
first time a place felt kinda like home.

Hirose-san, Captain Nagumo, Matsunaga-aniki,
Tagashira, even Tatsukawa... We were a family.
It never mattered how small we were.

After I joined the Hirose Family, it felt like
I actually had somewhere I belonged.
You know, Haruka had it pretty similar.

I know. I knew before she even
told me about her childhood.

Seeing how she kept her distance from others,
how she approached people... I could just tell.

She didn't have any "blood" to speak of
past her orphanage either, just like me.

But now because of me,
Haruka-chan is suffering again.

And who knows how much trouble I caused
the family by hiding what happened.

Even the boss risked his life to
keep her and Haruto safe, you know?
But... that's why I want to make it right.
And how are you going to do that?
I'm heading to Kamurocho tomorrow.
I'll break into the Saio HQ and talk to Lo.

Maybe I can convince him to just let
me and Haruto live in peace.
I know it won't be easy...

...But if I don't do something, they'll keep
going after Haruka-chan and Haruto!
I actually had the same idea.
You should tell Lo what you're thinking.

And if he doesn't accept it,
he'll have me to deal with.
And I'll tear the Saio Triad apart.
Let's end this madness together, Yuta.

Aniki. We should make sure Captain Nagumo
and the others don't worry about us.

We should tell them the plan
before we head up to Kamurocho.
Kiryu-san! Yuta-kun!

I'm so glad you're okay. Nagumo-kun told me
everything. It's good to see Haruto-kun safe, too.
I hope we didn't worry you, Mama.

Nagumo told me about you, too.
About how you're Haruto-kun's real father.
Sorry I didn't tell ya.
I'm actually not mad.
If anything, I'm relieved.
As am I.

Kiyomi-san. Kiryu-aniki and I are
heading up to Kamurocho soon.
We have a score to settle there.

Don't do anything too dangerous.
Oh, and... you're taking Haruto?

No matter where we go,
people will be coming for him.
At least if I'm close, I can protect him.

Right. That's a good idea.
Just take care of yourselves, okay?

Yeah, thanks. We'll stop by after we get back.
Come on, Yuta.
Oh, Aniki! Welcome back.
Yo!
Nice t'see ya!
Is Patriarch Hirose in?

Nah. He's out wanderin' around.
No idea where.
Did y'need somethin' from him?

Nothing in particular, no. Just wanted to tell him
Yuta and I are going to Kamurocho. Haruto, too.
Kamurocho?
Yeah. To the Saio Triad headquarters.

I'm going to cut ties with my father,
for Haruto's sake.

Though I gotta say, it sounds strange ending
things with one relative to protect another.

W-Well in that case, lemme tag along.
Jus' gimme a few n' I'll be ready.
No. This is between me and Yuta.
You stay here and keep your boss safe.

Depending on how the Yomei react,
he may need all the help he can get.
Huh? Why d'ya say that?

Weren't you the one who smacked
Koshimizu with a beer bottle last night?

The main family might
want to have a chat.

Nah, they got more important
things t'be worryin' about.
Hm? Like what?

Well, they found Masuzoe dead this mornin'.
Floatin' in the bay with a bullet in his brain.
I'd guess it was the Saio that offed him.

Probly 'cause he tried t'get out,
jus' like Tatsukawa.

I'm not so sure. In fact, Joon-gi Han
was shot in the head last night as well.

We can't rule out that both of
them were killed by the same guy.
Man, I'm gettin' the creeps.

Onomichi or Kamurocho... We ain't gonna
be safe no matter where we are.
Um, Kiryu-aniki.

I'm worried about things around here myself,
shouldn't we get moving to Kamurocho?
I'm ready t'go whenever.
Jus' let me know when you want to leave.
Aniki. Are you ready for Kamurocho?
Yeah, all set.
Okay then. Let's get going.
No, I still need to prepare.

No prob.
Jus' talk to me when you're ready.
Yuta, let's head over to Serena.

We can't take Haruto to Little Asia, so we
should ask Date-san to keep him safe.
Oh! Long time no see, Haruto-kun!

We might need to ask you for some
more help, Mama. Is Date-san around?
No, but shall I call him for you?

Yeah, thanks. I need to ask him to
babysit Haruto for a little while.
Somewhere other than here, preferably.

Some people are looking for Haruto,
so I need to make sure he stays hidden.

Oh, I see.
Give me just a sec.

So this guy was with Haruka?
I dunno... You sure he's the right guy?
Why, what's wrong with me?

It's just that I've known Haruka
almost her entire life.

Never figured she'd settle for a
yakuza boy from the Hiroshima sticks.
Not to mention the heir to the Saio Triad.
It is what it is.

If you got past Kiryu,
I've got no place to complain.

But still, Kiryu...
You're cool with this?

I am now. I had to punch him
through a glass door first, though.
Oh yeah? I shoulda guessed as much.
Date-san. Can I ask you to look after Haruto?

Yeah, I'll manage somehow.
Just leave him to me.

By the way, I've got news for you.
Tsuneo Iwami is up here from Onomichi.
What? When did he arrive?

Yesterday. Apparently he's here to
meet with Sugai over at Tojo HQ.

Some other Yomei yakuza are
gathering in Kamurocho, too.

It's really put the triads on edge.
Feels like the calm before the storm.
What is Tsuneo Iwami doing in Kamurocho?

Well, remember how the oath
between Koshimizu and Someya fell through?
Maybe he wants to give it another go.
That's just a hunch, though.

Oh, I could try calling the boss.
If anyone is gonna know something, it's him.
Aniki. Can you take Haruto?
Hey, Kiryu.

This is the worst possible time to go
busting in on the Saio to settle things.

They've got Little Asia on lockdown
with everything that's going on.
Can't you guys just wait a bit?

We don't have time for that.
Think about Joon-gi Han and Masuzoe.
We can't let the body count keep rising.

Hey, he's still not back.
You think he's done with his call?
Yuta?
What the... Is this Yuta's?
What's up, Kiryu?

Yuta's gone.
His phone's all that's left.

What do you mean, gone? Wait,
don't tell me he went to Little Asia alone!?

I'm not sure.
Date-san, look after Haruto for me!
Hello?

Aniki, it's Nagumo!
Is Yuta there with ya!?

W-We jus' found somethin'!
Yuta left a will fer us in the office!

He must've hid it in the trash so we wouldn't
notice. Aniki, he's suicidal!

He's gonna try'n kill Lo
t'protect his son!
Not if I can stop him!

(What are you doing, Yuta!?
Damn it, I have to hurry...!)
You again!? Kiryu!
Ed!
W-Wait! You can't go up there!

Lo's here, isn't he?
And what about Yuta!?

That little shit lit the place up.
Goddamn brat!
So Yuta <font_kind=yakuza_italic>is</font_kind> here.

You should run. Unless you'd
prefer to burn to death!

What irony. The very blood ties
the Saio Triad value so greatly...

...Are what ultimately transformed
my son into my would-be assassin.

Don't you dare talk about Yuta like that.
You have no business calling him your son!

I put far too much faith in our blood,
and in doing so squandered everything.

Once you realized I was plotting to murder
your son, my entire plan crumbled.

I expect you would refuse to take the
reins now, even if we threatened you.

So does this mean you're done
going after Haruto?
Are you finally gonna let him live in peace!?
Yes. The Saio Triad swears it.

We will never make another attempt
on either you or your child again.
However, I must make one thing clear.

Yuta. Today you acted as little more
than a pawn in a larger plot to kill me.
Wh-What do y'mean?

There is a man coordinating everything,
hoping to protect the secret of Onomichi.

As I am the only one alive who can divulge
the truth, he felt it necessary to be rid of me.

This man, under orders from
Yomei Alliance Chairman Kurusu...

...Became a deadly assassin who has killed
countless times to keep that secret safe.

And now, using the Saio Triad's blood ties
as his instrument, he incited Yuta to murder.

Well? Do you have any idea
of whom I speak?
No way... It can't be.
P-Patriarch Hirose?

Ridiculous! Why would he resort to
using Yuta as a tool like this!?

After Little Asia was passed to me,
and after my son Jimmy was killed...

Kurusu urged me to take my knowledge
of Onomichi and flee the country.

And the man who acted as his
messenger... was the man called Hirose.

The Saio are in a panic after the fire in
Little Asia and their boss going MIA.
They assume he's been kidnapped.

If they found out he was here...
It probably wouldn't be pretty.

I understand that. I doubt we'll
be able to keep him here for long.

But... There's something I'd like
to ask him first.
[Jimmy. This is your little brother.]
[Cute, huh?]
[Yeah!]
[However, this will be the last you see of him.]
[Why?]

[Well, this child is... a sort
of insurance policy for us.]

[Listen, Jimmy.
Remember these words well.]

[This is what it means to rule
over the Saio Triad.]

[For the good of the many,
you must be willing to cast aside your family.]
[What do you mean?]

[You are my only son, Jimmy.
I need no other.]

[Dad! Hey, Dad!
Are you even listening?]
[Why can't we expand into Japan?]

[If Ed and I struck now, we could wipe the yakuza
 out
while they're distracted by their anti-crime law!]
[Dad, give me this chance!]
[This rubbish again?]
[We've been through this.]

[We are forbidden from setting foot in Japan.
That is the key to our agreement with the Yomei.]

[So let me get this straight. You're putting
some backwater clan over your own people?]
[Hey. This is not your call to make.]

[And... for now, perhaps
you had better watch your tone?]

[Dad<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>I mean, boss.
The Saio Triad is facing its greatest peril.]

[With the police cracking down like they are,
any hope we had of domestic expansion is lost.]

[But we've been shipping <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind> to Japan
through the Yomei for years now.]

[The groundwork for our
 expansion
into Japan is done. Why not act on it!?]

[Give me a chance here, Dad!
I'll take Tokyo, I promise you!]

[And how will you do that?
The Tojo Clan rules that city.]
[They may be shackled by anti-crime laws now...]

[...But they're still yakuza. They will not sit
back and let you steal their territory.]
[We enlist the Yomei Alliance's help, then.]

[What about that secret of Onomichi? We can
use it to blackmail Kurusu into helping us.]
[You just need to tell me what it is.]

[With Kurusu on our side, we could
bring Kamurocho to its knees.]

[And from there, Ed and I would fan
out to take control of the whole city.]

[Don't be so naive. You really expect
Kurusu would agree to your plan?]
[He'd have to!]

[They take our <font_kind=yakuza_italic>heihaizi</font_kind>, despite
gaining any real value from doing so.]

[It's proof that their secret would give
us even more leverage over them!]
[These were your words, right?]
[Jimmy.]

[It's time to cast aside the Yomei.
Just give me this opportunity.]
[Teach me the secret of Onomichi, Dad!]

[There is something you must
understand about this situation.]
[Yes?]

[We can no longer use the secret of Onomichi
to blackmail Kurusu. As for why...]
